market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100 on May 6. $85 requires ~15% drop in ~25 days. Iran ceasefire/deal news already pushing prices lower; supply normalization could continue. With Iran de-escalation underway and UAE OPEC exit potentially adding supply, a drop to $85 is plausible but counter to supply-shock setup.
assessment.key_uncertainty: How quickly Iran/Hormuz situation normalizes vs. flares again.
